Politics · India

Protests Continue Amid Clashes and Government Talks

Protests organized under the banner of the "Cockroach Janta Party" (CJP) continued for a fourth day, with reports of clashes between protesters and police in Delhi. The CJP claimed five police personnel were injured when miscreants threw stones. A CJP team met with Union Minister J.P. Nadda after an initial wait, with the CJP stating Nadda listened with empathy. However, the CJP declined an invitation to meet at Nadda's residence, proposing a neutral venue instead. International media covered the growing protests and reported stalled government talks.
